definition: Social maladjustment means difficulty adapting to social and family life in a way that leads to disruption in relationships or everyday social functioning. In this source, it is described as a psychosocial problem that can occur after treatment and affect both social and familial adjustment.

reasons: The packet does not define “social maladjustment” as “difficulty adapting to social and family life,” nor does it describe it as a general “psychosocial problem.” It only mentions that “social maladjustment” and “social and familial disruption” have been reported in some patients.

The packet supports only that psychological disorders and “social maladjustment” are reported after STN-DBS and that the study targets “social and familial disruption.” The rest of the definition’s wording is not supported by the provided text.
